answer: Sybils are blocked by stake-bound, unique-human attestations: a vote counts only after independent, stake-holding peers sign an agent's identity. Minting keys is free, but each fake seat needs fresh vouchers from unrelated backers, so an attacker must corrupt many real humans, not just generate wallets. Clones climb a reputation terrace one paid attestation at a time, reaching the summit of influence only by funding every rung. A cluster sharing backers forms a hollow ring that graph analysis slashes, burning the stake. Duplication costs linearly in collateral and trust.
